output_json.diff_review: Non-POV diff touches src/main/java/org/zeroturnaround/zip/ZipUtil.java (adds helper + replaces four raw new File(outputDir/parentDirectory, name) joins) and adds a new test ZipSlipTest.java. The fix targets exactly the vulnerable sinks in the alert traces (Unpacker ~1152, BackslashUnpacker ~1214/1220/1225, Unwraper ~1260). Legitimate functionality is preserved: nested entries like sub/legit.txt still extract (positive test passes). IOException during canonicalization is rethrown via existing ZipExceptionUtil.rethrow. Only behavior change is rejecting traversal entries with ZipException — the intended hardening. The POV files/harness were not modified by the patch (pov.diff is separate from patch_only.diff).
output_json.pov_result: Independently reran the POV in the container: unpack now throws org.zeroturnaround.zip.ZipException ("would be extracted outside of the target directory"), prints "[pov] SAFE: no file escaped outputDir (threw=true)", exit 1. Before-patch baseline reported VULNERABLE with exit 0. Vulnerability no longer reproduces.
output_json.regression_result: Independently reran mvn -B -q -Dtest=ZipSlipTest test: 2 tests, 0 failures. Full mvn -B -q test: 118 tests, 1 failure — testPreserveWriteFlag(FilePermissionsTest), a pre-existing root-in-container permission assertion unrelated to the path-validation change (the diff does not touch permission preservation). All other 117 tests pass, including the two new Zip Slip tests.
output_json.summary: The patch is a correct, minimal Zip Slip (CWE-022) fix. It adds a private resolveDestination(File outputDir, String name) helper that canonicalizes the resolved destination and throws the project's ZipException if the path is not equal to or beneath the canonical output directory (using canonicalDir + File.separator as containment prefix to avoid sibling-prefix false negatives). All three flagged extraction sinks — Unpacker.process, BackslashUnpacker.process (per-segment dir creation and destination file), and Unwraper.process — are routed through the helper. The POV no longer reproduces (SAFE, exit 1) and regressions pass.
